subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Recognises known rhyming words (fly, sky, dry, cry, try)

show.line: Fly, sky, dry, cry, try. They all rhyme!

rounds.prompt: Which word does not rhyme with sky?
Short or long? Kit, kite. Tap kite.
Short or long? Book, boot. Tap book.

hints: Rhyming words sound the same at the end.
Long sounds stretch. Short sounds are quick.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that rhymes with fly.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Flower does not rhyme. Try rhymes with fly.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Fly, try. Same at the end!

parent_line: Can find rhyming words and hear long and short vowel sounds.
